expertiseSources.summary: Defines observable behavior assertions, test-level selection, isolation, deterministic boundaries, and meaningful regression evidence.

exception.rationale: The workflow retains observed red/green evidence and required regression gates. The revision distinguishes failed or uncertain write-tool results from unchanged state: inspect actual applied and pending changes, preserve unrelated work, and retry only the unapplied remainder. Generic behavior cases request review of partial-write recovery without weakening assertions; no measured output-quality gain or completed human approval is claimed.
